approvalTitle: Tasks: Shop Search Integration (29 tasks, TDD-first)
content:
# Tasks Document: Shop Search Integration

## Domain Layer (Value Objects & Interfaces)

- [ ] 1. Create ShopLocation Value Object
  - File: lib/domain/value-objects/shop-location.ts
  - Implement ShopLocation VO with latitude/longitude validation
  - Add isValid(), toString(), distanceTo() methods
  - Purpose: Represent geographic coordinates with validation
  - _Leverage: lib/domain/value-objects/ (existing VO patterns)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 2 (Shop Information Storage Schema)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Domain-Driven Design specialist with expertise in Value Objects | Task: Create ShopLocation Value Object with latitude/longitude validation (-90 to 90, -180 to 180), implementing isValid(), toString(), and distanceTo() methods following DDD principles | Restrictions: Must be immutable, no dependencies on Infrastructure/Presentation layers, validate inputs in constructor | Success: VO is immutable, throws errors for invalid coordinates, all methods work correctly, follows existing VO patterns in lib/domain/value-objects/_

- [ ] 2. Create ShopSearchResult Value Object
  - File: lib/domain/value-objects/shop-search-result.ts
  - Implement ShopSearchResult VO with name, address, location, source
  - Add displayText getter
  - Purpose: Represent shop search results in domain layer
  - _Leverage: lib/domain/value-objects/, ShopLocation_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search), Requirement 5 (Ubiquitous Language)_
  - _Prompt: Role: DDD specialist focusing on domain model purity | Task: Create ShopSearchResult Value Object with name (required), address (nullable), location (ShopLocation | null), source ('database' | 'nominatim'), and displayText getter following Ubiquitous Language | Restrictions: Must be immutable, no conversion methods (toFormData/fromNominatim/fromDatabase), validate empty names, maintain layer independence | Success: VO is pure domain model, immutable, displayText combines name and address correctly, follows Ubiquitous Language terminology_

- [ ] 3. Create Domain Service Interface
  - File: lib/domain/services/shop-search-service.interface.ts
  - Define IShopSearchService interface with searchShops method
  - Document expected behavior and error cases
  - Purpose: Establish domain service contract
  - _Leverage: lib/domain/services/ (existing service patterns)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Software Architect specializing in Clean Architecture interfaces | Task: Define IShopSearchService interface with searchShops(query: string, maxResults: number) method, documenting expected behavior for empty queries, deduplication, and error cases | Restrictions: Must be in Domain layer, no Infrastructure dependencies, use domain types only | Success: Interface clearly defines contract, includes JSDoc comments, follows existing service interface patterns_

## Infrastructure Layer (External Integrations)

- [ ] 4. Create Nominatim API types and client interface
  - File: lib/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-types.ts
  - File: lib/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-client.interface.ts
  - Define NominatimPlace, NominatimSearchOptions interfaces
  - Define INominatimClient interface
  - Purpose: Type-safe Nominatim API integration contracts
  - _Leverage: None (new external integration)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 4 (API Integration with Error Handling)_
  - _Prompt: Role: TypeScript expert with REST API integration experience | Task: Create NominatimPlace interface matching Nominatim API response (name, display_name, address, lat, lon), NominatimSearchOptions with countrycodes, limit, format, accept-language, addressdetails, extratags, amenity fields, and INominatimClient interface with search() and canMakeRequest() methods | Restrictions: Follow Nominatim API documentation exactly, use proper TypeScript types, document required headers | Success: Types match Nominatim API structure, options support Japan-specific filtering ('jp', 'ja', 'cafe,restaurant'), interface is clear and testable_

- [ ] 5. Create Rate Limiter interface and Supabase implementation
  - File: lib/infrastructure/rate-limiter/rate-limiter.interface.ts
  - File: lib/infrastructure/rate-limiter/supabase-rate-limiter.ts
  - Implement IRateLimiter with canMakeRequest(), recordRequest(), waitUntilReady()
  - Implement SupabaseRateLimiter using PostgreSQL row locking
  - Purpose: Enforce 1 request/second limit across serverless instances
  - _Leverage: lib/infrastructure/supabase-client.ts_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (rate limiting), Requirement 4 (API compliance)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend engineer with serverless architecture expertise | Task: Create IRateLimiter interface and SupabaseRateLimiter implementation using rate_limiter_state table with FOR UPDATE row locking to ensure 1 req/sec limit across multiple Vercel instances | Restrictions: Must work in serverless, handle concurrent requests safely, use PostgreSQL transactions, no in-memory state | Success: Rate limiter enforces 1 req/sec globally, works across multiple instances, handles race conditions with row locking, fails gracefully on DB errors_

- [ ] 6. Create database migration for rate_limiter_state table
  - File: supabase/migrations/[timestamp]_create_rate_limiter_state.sql
  - Create rate_limiter_state table (service, last_request_at, updated_at)
  - Add appropriate indexes
  - Purpose: Shared state store for rate limiting
  - _Leverage: supabase/migrations/ (existing migration patterns)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 4 (API Integration)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Database administrator with PostgreSQL expertise | Task: Create migration for rate_limiter_state table with service (TEXT PRIMARY KEY), last_request_at (TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()), ensuring idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS | Restrictions: Must be idempotent, no data loss on re-run, follow existing migration naming conventions | Success: Migration creates table successfully, can be run multiple times safely, follows project conventions in supabase/migrations/_

- [ ] 7. Write unit tests for SupabaseRateLimiter
  - File: __tests__/infrastructure/rate-limiter/supabase-rate-limiter.test.ts
  - Test canMakeRequest(), recordRequest(), waitUntilReady()
  - Test concurrent request handling with mocked DB
  - Purpose: Ensure rate limiter reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: __tests__/setup.ts (existing test setup)_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with expertise in TDD and async testing | Task: Write comprehensive unit tests for SupabaseRateLimiter covering: first request (canMakeRequest=true), second request within 1s (canMakeRequest=false), recordRequest updates DB, waitUntilReady waits ~1s, concurrent requests handled safely, DB errors handled gracefully | Restrictions: Must mock Supabase client, test with fake timers (jest.useFakeTimers), follow TDD Red-Green-Refactor, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All rate limiter behaviors tested, mocks properly isolate DB, tests pass and validate 1 req/sec enforcement_

- [ ] 8. Implement Nominatim HTTP client
  - File: lib/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-client.ts
  - Implement NominatimClient with search() method
  - Add proper User-Agent, Referer headers
  - Handle 429, 503, network errors gracefully
  - Purpose: HTTP client for Nominatim API
  - _Leverage: INominatimClient interface, IRateLimiter_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 4 (API Integration with Error Handling)_
  - _Prompt: Role: API integration specialist with error handling expertise | Task: Implement NominatimClient.search() using fetch API with User-Agent: "SimpleCoffeeCollections/1.0", Referer headers, integrating IRateLimiter.canMakeRequest() check before requests, handling 429 (return empty), 503 (return empty), network errors (log and return empty) | Restrictions: Must respect rate limiter, no retry on 429/503, log all errors with timestamp, use Japanese language preference | Success: Client enforces rate limit, handles all error cases gracefully without throwing, logs errors properly, returns empty array on failures_

- [ ] 9. Write unit tests for NominatimClient
  - File: __tests__/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-client.test.ts
  - Test search() with mocked fetch
  - Test rate limiter integration
  - Test error handling (429, 503, network)
  - Purpose: Ensure API client reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: __tests__/setup.ts, jest.fn() for mocking_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with API testing expertise | Task: Write unit tests for NominatimClient covering: successful search with proper headers, rate limiter blocking requests, 429 error returns empty array, 503 error returns empty array, network error returns empty array, all errors are logged | Restrictions: Mock global fetch, mock IRateLimiter, use TDD approach, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All API client behaviors tested, fetch mocked properly, error handling validated, tests verify headers and rate limiting_

- [ ] 10. Create NominatimMapper for API response conversion
  - File: lib/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-mapper.ts
  - Implement NominatimMapper.toShopSearchResult()
  - Handle address formatting (road, city, country)
  - Purpose: Convert Nominatim API responses to domain VOs
  - _Leverage: ShopSearchResult, ShopLocation VOs_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Data transformation specialist with TypeScript expertise | Task: Create NominatimMapper.toShopSearchResult() static method converting NominatimPlace to ShopSearchResult, formatting address from road/city/country, parsing lat/lon to ShopLocation, using name or display_name, setting source='nominatim' | Restrictions: Must be in Infrastructure layer, handle null/undefined address parts, validate lat/lon before creating ShopLocation | Success: Mapper correctly converts API responses, handles missing fields gracefully, produces valid ShopSearchResult VOs, address formatting is readable_

- [ ] 11. Write unit tests for NominatimMapper
  - File: __tests__/infrastructure/nominatim/nominatim-mapper.test.ts
  - Test toShopSearchResult() with various API responses
  - Test null/missing field handling
  - Purpose: Ensure data conversion reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: ShopSearchResult, ShopLocation VOs_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with data transformation testing expertise | Task: Write unit tests for NominatimMapper.toShopSearchResult() covering: complete API response, missing address parts, missing lat/lon, only display_name (no name), verify source='nominatim', verify address formatting | Restrictions: Test all edge cases, use TDD approach, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All conversion scenarios tested, null handling validated, ShopSearchResult creation verified, address formatting tested_

- [ ] 12. Create ShopRepository and ShopRepositoryMapper
  - File: lib/infrastructure/repositories/shop-repository.ts
  - File: lib/infrastructure/repositories/shop-repository-mapper.ts
  - Implement IShopRepository.findExistingShops() using Supabase
  - Implement ShopRepositoryMapper.toShopSearchResult()
  - Purpose: Query existing shops from database
  - _Leverage: lib/infrastructure/supabase-client.ts, ShopSearchResult VO_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Database integration specialist with Supabase expertise | Task: Implement ShopRepository.findExistingShops(query, limit) using Supabase .select('shop_name, shop_address, shop_latitude, shop_longitude').ilike('shop_name', `%${query}%`).limit(limit), and ShopRepositoryMapper.toShopSearchResult() converting DB records to ShopSearchResult with source='database' | Restrictions: Use Supabase parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection, handle null address/lat/lon, map DB column names correctly | Success: Repository queries existing shops efficiently, mapper handles all nullable fields, source is set to 'database', follows existing repository patterns_

- [ ] 13. Write unit tests for ShopRepository and mapper
  - File: __tests__/infrastructure/repositories/shop-repository.test.ts
  - File: __tests__/infrastructure/repositories/shop-repository-mapper.test.ts
  - Test findExistingShops() with mocked Supabase
  - Test mapper with various DB records
  - Purpose: Ensure repository reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: __tests__/setup.ts, mock Supabase client_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with database testing expertise | Task: Write unit tests for ShopRepository.findExistingShops() and ShopRepositoryMapper.toShopSearchResult() covering: successful query, empty results, ILIKE pattern matching, null address/lat/lon handling, verify source='database', verify column mapping | Restrictions: Mock Supabase client, test isolation, TDD approach, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All repository methods tested, Supabase mocked properly, mapper null handling validated, query patterns verified_

## Application Layer (Use Cases)

- [ ] 14. Implement SearchShopUseCase
  - File: lib/application/use-cases/search-shop-use-case.ts
  - Implement SearchShopUseCase with execute(query, maxResults) method
  - Orchestrate: DB search first → check count → conditional API call → merge → deduplicate
  - Purpose: Business logic for shop search
  - _Leverage: IShopRepository, INominatimClient, ShopSearchResult_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Application layer architect with use case pattern expertise | Task: Implement SearchShopUseCase.execute() orchestrating: 1) query IShopRepository.findExistingShops(query, 5), 2) if results < 3, query INominatimClient.search(query, 5-count), 3) merge results, 4) deduplicate by name (case-insensitive), 5) return max 5 results | Restrictions: Sequential execution (NOT parallel), no domain logic in use case, dependency inject repositories via constructor, validate query (3-100 chars) | Success: Use case orchestrates correctly, conditional API call works, deduplication prevents duplicates, max 5 results enforced, query validation implemented_

- [ ] 15. Write unit tests for SearchShopUseCase
  - File: __tests__/application/use-cases/search-shop-use-case.test.ts
  - Test execute() with mocked dependencies
  - Test all orchestration scenarios
  - Purpose: Ensure use case logic reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: Mock IShopRepository, INominatimClient_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with use case testing expertise | Task: Write comprehensive unit tests for SearchShopUseCase.execute() covering: DB results ≥3 (no API call), DB results <3 (API called with limit 5-count), deduplication (same name different sources), max 5 results, query validation (too short, too long, valid), error handling (repository errors, API errors) | Restrictions: Mock all dependencies, test business logic only, TDD approach, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All orchestration paths tested, conditional API call validated, deduplication works, validation tested, error handling verified_

## Database Schema

- [ ] 16. Create database migration for shop columns
  - File: supabase/migrations/[timestamp]_add_shop_location_fields.sql
  - Add shop_address (TEXT NULL), shop_latitude (NUMERIC NULL), shop_longitude (NUMERIC NULL)
  - Ensure backward compatibility (nullable columns)
  - Purpose: Store shop location data
  - _Leverage: supabase/migrations/ (existing migrations), coffee_evaluations table_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 2 (Shop Information Storage Schema)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Database administrator with migration expertise | Task: Create migration adding shop_address (TEXT NULL), shop_latitude (NUMERIC NULL), shop_longitude (NUMERIC NULL) to coffee_evaluations table using ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for idempotence, ensuring existing data is unaffected | Restrictions: Must be idempotent, backward compatible (nullable), no data loss, follow existing migration patterns | Success: Migration adds columns successfully, existing records have NULL values, can be run multiple times safely, follows project conventions_

- [ ] 17. Write integration test for database migration
  - File: __tests__/integration/migrations/shop-location-fields.test.ts
  - Test migration adds columns correctly
  - Test rollback removes columns
  - Test existing data preserved
  - Purpose: Ensure migration safety (TDD)
  - _Leverage: Supabase test client, existing integration test setup_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (Integration Tests)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with database migration testing expertise | Task: Write integration tests for shop location fields migration covering: migration adds 3 columns, existing coffee_evaluations records have NULL in new columns, new records can save shop data, rollback removes columns successfully | Restrictions: Use test database, clean up after tests, verify schema changes, test with real Supabase client | Success: Migration tested end-to-end, existing data preservation verified, rollback tested, schema changes validated_

## Presentation Layer (Server Actions & UI)

- [ ] 18. Implement searchShopAction Server Action
  - File: lib/actions/shop-search.ts
  - Implement searchShopAction(query: string) Server Action
  - Integrate SearchShopUseCase with dependency injection
  - Add React cache() for request deduplication
  - Purpose: Server-side entry point for shop search
  - _Leverage: SearchShopUseCase, lib/actions/ (existing action patterns)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Next.js specialist with Server Actions expertise | Task: Implement searchShopAction Server Action with React cache() wrapper, creating SearchShopUseCase with SupabaseRepository and NominatimClient, calling useCase.execute(query, 5), returning success/error response format, adding 'use server' directive | Restrictions: Must use 'use server', wrap with cache() for deduplication, validate query length (3-100), return structured response { success, data/error }, use env variables for configuration | Success: Server Action works from client components, cache() prevents duplicate requests, validation works, error responses are user-friendly, follows existing action patterns_

- [ ] 19. Write integration tests for searchShopAction
  - File: __tests__/integration/actions/shop-search.test.ts
  - Test searchShopAction with real Supabase
  - Test cache() deduplication
  - Purpose: Ensure Server Action reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: Supabase test client, existing action test setup_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (Integration Tests)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer with Next.js integration testing expertise | Task: Write integration tests for searchShopAction covering: valid query returns results, query <3 chars returns error, query >100 chars returns error, cache() deduplication (same query in one render), DB + API integration works, error handling (DB down, API down) | Restrictions: Use test database, test with real Supabase, verify cache() behavior, test error scenarios | Success: All Server Action behaviors tested, cache deduplication validated, integration with DB/API verified, error handling tested_

- [ ] 20. Create ShopSearchInput component
  - File: components/shop-search/shop-search-input.tsx
  - Implement controlled input with debounced search (300ms)
  - Show loading indicator during search
  - Display dropdown with results
  - Purpose: User interface for shop search
  - _Leverage: components/ (existing component patterns), shadcn/ui components_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 3 (Form UX Enhancement)_
  - _Prompt: Role: React developer with UI/UX expertise | Task: Create ShopSearchInput component with controlled input, useDebounce hook (300ms), calling searchShopAction on change (≥3 chars), showing loading spinner during search, rendering dropdown with results using SearchResultItem components, keyboard navigation (↑↓Enter), accessibility (ARIA labels) | Restrictions: Must be client component ('use client'), use shadcn/ui Input/Popover, debounce at 300ms, minimum 3 chars to trigger, handle empty results gracefully | Success: Component triggers search after 300ms, shows loading state, dropdown displays results, keyboard navigation works, accessible, follows existing component patterns_

- [ ] 21. Create SearchResultItem component
  - File: components/shop-search/search-result-item.tsx
  - Implement result item displaying name, address
  - Handle click to select shop
  - Purpose: Display individual search result
  - _Leverage: ShopSearchResult VO, shadcn/ui components_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 3 (Form UX Enhancement)_
  - _Prompt: Role: React developer with component design expertise | Task: Create SearchResultItem component displaying shop name, address (if available), handling onClick to emit selected shop data, using Card/CardContent from shadcn/ui, ensuring touch-friendly size (min 44px height) | Restrictions: Must be presentation component, receive ShopSearchResult as prop, emit onSelect callback, use shadcn/ui theming, mobile-optimized | Success: Component displays name and address clearly, clickable with good touch target, emits selection correctly, responsive design, follows existing patterns_

- [ ] 22. Integrate ShopSearchInput into EvaluationForm
  - File: components/evaluation-form/evaluation-form.tsx
  - Replace shop_name text input with ShopSearchInput
  - Handle selection to populate address/lat/lon fields
  - Maintain backward compatibility for manual input
  - Purpose: Add shop search to coffee evaluation form
  - _Leverage: Existing EvaluationForm, ShopSearchInput component_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (Server-Side Shop Search), Requirement 3 (Form UX)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Full-stack developer with form integration expertise | Task: Integrate ShopSearchInput into EvaluationForm replacing shop_name input, adding onSelect handler to populate hidden shop_address, shop_latitude, shop_longitude fields, allowing manual override of shop_name, ensuring form submission includes all shop fields | Restrictions: Must maintain backward compatibility (manual input still works), use form state management (react-hook-form), validate shop_name still required, preserve existing form validation | Success: ShopSearchInput integrated seamlessly, selection populates all shop fields, manual input still possible, form submission works with new fields, existing form behavior preserved_

- [ ] 23. Write component tests for ShopSearchInput
  - File: __tests__/components/shop-search/shop-search-input.test.tsx
  - Test input, debouncing, loading state, results display
  - Test keyboard navigation
  - Purpose: Ensure UI component reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend QA Engineer with React Testing Library expertise | Task: Write component tests for ShopSearchInput covering: typing triggers search after 300ms, <3 chars no search, loading indicator shows during fetch, results display in dropdown, clicking result calls onSelect, keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/Up/Enter), empty state message, error handling | Restrictions: Use Testing Library queries (getByRole, etc.), mock searchShopAction, use fake timers for debounce, test accessibility, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All component behaviors tested, debouncing validated, user interactions tested, keyboard navigation verified, accessible, follows existing test patterns_

- [ ] 24. Write component tests for SearchResultItem
  - File: __tests__/components/shop-search/search-result-item.test.tsx
  - Test rendering with/without address
  - Test click handler
  - Purpose: Ensure result item reliability (TDD)
  - _Leverage: @testing-library/react_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (TDD Mandatory)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend QA Engineer with component testing expertise | Task: Write component tests for SearchResultItem covering: renders name and address, renders name only (no address), clicking calls onSelect with correct data, touch target is ≥44px, displays displayText correctly | Restrictions: Use Testing Library, test presentation only, mock onSelect callback, verify accessibility, achieve 80%+ coverage | Success: All rendering scenarios tested, click handler verified, touch target size validated, displayText tested, accessible_

## End-to-End Testing

- [ ] 25. Write E2E test for shop search flow
  - File: e2e/shop-search.spec.ts
  - Test complete flow: form → search → select → submit → verify
  - Test on mobile and desktop viewports
  - Purpose: Validate critical user journey (TDD)
  - _Leverage: Playwright, e2e/README.md, existing E2E setup_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (E2E Tests - Playwright)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Automation Engineer with Playwright expertise | Task: Write E2E test covering: navigate to evaluation form, type shop name (≥3 chars), wait 300ms, verify dropdown appears, click shop result, verify address/lat/lon populated, submit form, verify coffee_evaluations record has shop data, test on mobile (375x667) and desktop (1280x720) viewports | Restrictions: Use real Nominatim API (or mock if rate limit concerns), clean up test data after, use Playwright best practices, test critical path only | Success: E2E test validates complete user journey, works on both viewports, data persists to database, test is reliable and maintainable, follows e2e/README.md patterns_

- [ ] 26. Write E2E test for manual shop input fallback
  - File: e2e/shop-search-fallback.spec.ts
  - Test manual input when search returns no results
  - Test form submission with manual shop_name only
  - Purpose: Validate backward compatibility (TDD)
  - _Leverage: Playwright, existing E2E setup_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 1 (backward compatibility)_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Automation Engineer with edge case testing expertise | Task: Write E2E test covering: type shop name with no results, verify "手入力で追加できます" message, manually enter shop_name, submit form, verify record saved with shop_name only (NULL address/lat/lon), ensure existing manual flow still works | Restrictions: Test graceful degradation, verify backward compatibility, clean up test data, use Playwright best practices | Success: Manual input fallback tested, backward compatibility verified, NULL values handled correctly, test is reliable_

## Documentation and Cleanup

- [ ] 27. Update Ubiquitous Language Dictionary
  - File: docs/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE_DICTIONARY.md
  - Add ShopSearchResult, ShopLocation, ShopAddress terms
  - Document search-related terminology
  - Purpose: Maintain consistent domain language
  - _Leverage: docs/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE_DICTIONARY.md (existing terms)_
  - _Requirements: Requirement 5 (Ubiquitous Language Compliance)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Technical writer with DDD expertise | Task: Add new domain terms to UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE_DICTIONARY.md: ShopSearchResult (検索結果), ShopLocation (位置情報), ShopAddress (住所), SearchSource (検索ソース), update existing ShopInfo term, include code usage examples and UI text guidelines | Restrictions: Follow existing dictionary format, use Japanese for UI terms, maintain alphabetical order, include cross-references | Success: New terms documented clearly, examples provided, consistent with existing entries, easy to reference for future development_

- [ ] 28. Verify test coverage and cleanup
  - Run jest --coverage and verify ≥80% coverage
  - Fix any failing tests
  - Clean up console.logs and TODO comments
  - Purpose: Ensure code quality standards
  - _Leverage: package.json test scripts_
  - _Requirements: Testing Requirements (80%+ coverage)_
  - _Prompt: Role: Senior developer with code quality expertise | Task: Run test coverage report, verify ≥80% for all files (statements, branches, functions, lines), identify uncovered code and add tests if needed, remove console.logs, resolve TODO comments, ensure all tests pass in CI | Restrictions: Must achieve 80%+ coverage, no failing tests, no debug code in production, maintain test quality | Success: Coverage ≥80%, all tests passing, no console.logs or TODOs, code is clean and production-ready_

## Implementation Log

- [ ] 29. Log implementation artifacts after completion
  - Use spec-workflow log-implementation tool
  - Document all APIs, components, functions, integrations
  - Purpose: Create searchable knowledge base for future
  - _Leverage: mcp__spec-workflow__log-implementation tool_
  - _Requirements: All requirements_
  - _Prompt: Role: Technical documenter with comprehensive artifact tracking expertise | Task: After ALL tasks completed, use log-implementation tool to record detailed artifacts including: apiEndpoints (searchShopAction route/format), components (ShopSearchInput, SearchResultItem with props/exports), functions (SearchShopUseCase, NominatimClient, RateLimiter methods), classes (mappers, repositories), integrations (ShopSearchInput → searchShopAction → Nominatim API flow), filesModified, filesCreated, statistics (lines added/removed) | Restrictions: MUST include ALL artifact types, provide complete details with file locations and signatures, be thorough for future discoverability | Success: Comprehensive implementation log created with all APIs, components, functions, classes, integrations documented in detail for future AI agents to discover and prevent duplication_
